© Robert Bosch GmbH. All rights reserved, also regarding any disposal, exploitation, reproduction, editing, distribution, as well as in the event of application for industrial property rights. 
4 
Manufacturing 
The steelmaking processes (e.g., melting, secondary metallurgy, casting) are to be ensured with regard to high require-
ments in order to avoid macroscopic defects, non-metallic inclusions and defects. 
The steelmaking and production of the semi-finished material up to the product to be delivered follow the Control Plans in 
accordance with IATF 16949:2016-10. The Control Plans are referenced in the initial sample test report. 
5 
Defects 
5.1 General 
In accordance with state-of-the-art technology, the products have to be free from defects, which impair 
 
the processability under real production conditions 
 
the use under real service conditions. 
Details may be agreed relating to the component. 
5.2 Macroscopic internal defects 
Macroscopic internal defects are e.g. 
 
non-metallic inclusions with a surface of more than 0,03 mm² in their largest dimension 
 
internal discontinuities as e.g. blowholes, pores or internal cracks with a surface of more than 0,03 mm² in the 
largest dimension 
Quantity and size of macroscopic internal defects must not exceed the current state-of-the-art technology. State-of-the-art 
measures are to be taken in order to avoid the occurrence of macroscopic internal defects. Material with a heightened risk 
of such defects must not be delivered. In particular, any deviation from the control plan can heighten the risk. 
6 
Chemical composition (product analysis) 
6.1 
Deviating from DIN EN 10277:2018-09 
Elements not listed below must not be added to the steel intentionally without approval by the orderer, with the exception 
of the final treatment of the melt. All adequate preparations have to be made in order to avoid the addition of such ele-
ments from the scrap and other materials used in manufacturing that impair the mechanical properties and the usability of 
the steel. 
Mass fraction in % 
Mass fraction in % 
C 
0,04 to 0,10 
P 
max. 0,15 
Si 
max. 0,09 
S 
0,25 to 0,35 
Mn 
0,99 to 1,26
